<thought>Based on the 13C NMR data, the molecule contains a carbonyl carbon (~196 ppm) and two identical phenyl rings (12 aromatic carbons, four distinct aromatic shifts). This pattern matches diphenyl ketone (benzophenone). The structure can be thought of as a phenyl fragment joined to a benzoyl fragment (phenyl‑C(=O)‑). Therefore the fragments that can be linked are a phenyl ring and a benzoyl phenyl fragment.</thought>
<final_answer>['C1=CC=CC=C1', 'C(=O)C1=CC=CC=C1']</final_answer>
